exposure: Apgar score at 1 min (mild and severe depression)
cohort: The study included all preterm neonates (<37 weeks gestational age) admitted to the NICU of Guillermo Almenara National Hospital in Lima, Peru, in 2022.
finding: Extremely low birth weight, abnormal Apgar scores at 1 min, and hypoglycemia were identified as key determinants of mortality in preterm infants in intensive care.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not a significant predictor of in-hospital mortality after adjustment.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from preterm neonates admitted to the NICU in 2022.
birth_weight: N/A (Extremely low birth weight (<1000g) was a measured exposure factor)
